<script>
// Move category pills from the margin sidebar to above the listing grid
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  var cats = document.querySelector('.quarto-listing-category');
  var listing = document.querySelector('#all-posts');
  if (cats && listing) {
    // Move the category element right before the listing
    listing.parentElement.insertBefore(cats, listing);
  }
});
</script>
